work.author: Clemens PP. Decimus "T'rtius
work.description: Entire raw XV 12254–12477 plus 20 LF context read. Disjoint refinement removes prior XIV continuation 12266–12323, and removes following XVI marginal dating/request summaries 12427–12442. Retains XV title, Venerabiles Fratres, numbered paragraphs 1–5, cardinal nomination, conventional Auctoritate etc. and In nomine Patris etc. completion. Literal running head 12444 identifies Clement; no abbreviation expanded. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
work.title: Oratio de nominatione Caroli Rezzonici in Cardinalem
